column2: device has not been going into low power state

column2: then puts it into a powered-up state ready to be

column1: re-loaded with uCode and re-started.  This has needlessly warmed up user's

resetting device after firmware errors)
column2: there is no need for apm_ops.reset()

column1: any more; apm_ops.reset() is basically a combination of apm_ops.stop() and

column1: the device retains the ability to sense the hardware RF-KILL switch
